decisions.reason: As a variant-heavy devore line overlapping with other burnout options, its carrying cost is relatively high and the firm has many similar options, so the option is less valuable.
Transparent burnout overlaps closely with other decorative sheers and requires several models, raising costs while the firm holds many options, making drop more likely.
A single basic burnout fabric is a low-cost option that keeps a foothold in decorative sheers while uncertainty about that segment remains.
Velour-like upholstery builds on the core upholstery offer and has stable demand, so its option value likely exceeds its low carrying cost.
Flame-retardant fabric offers access to contract and safety-driven markets, giving it upside option value that justifies continued investment.
Polyester lining with satin sheen is a functional complement with low carrying cost, so keeping it as an option is inexpensive while its value remains uncertain.
